body: The speeding citation is stamped after the access lane's closure; the beer at the gate is still sealed, and the appeal line says its driver was taking a child home.
title: A citation after closing

cites.quote: take your beer out to the track!

gloss: A traffic citation follows a venue access closure while a race-day purchase goes unused.
rival_reading: The venue could have closed that lane after an ordinary race incident, with a patrol citing a late driver afterward; the appeal cannot establish a wider order.

body:
Keep the infield closed until the pesticide trial dries. The first heat remains on the board, so the groundskeeper has to refund a child's ticket from his own coffee jar.

Our copy stayed on the kitchen table. The official account came later and asked us to remember a much shorter day.

When I returned, the window was closed and the board was blank. I kept the page because it was the only one with our address.
title: The infield stays closed
gloss: A trial-related closure conflicts with an event that remains advertised.
rival_reading: A response crew may have ordered routine grounds treatment while the event remained on the board; the refund says nothing about why access was restricted.
